question.question:
D1 — Review focus for the landing page plan
Project/branch/task: PLAN.md on main, marketing landing page.
ELI10: I rated this plan 2/10. The biggest gaps: everything is centered, the headline is cramped against the subhead, and the main button looks the same as the 'Learn more' link, so visitors don't know what to click. Mockups are skipped (designer not installed). I can review all 7 dimensions, or focus on a few.
Stakes if we pick wrong: narrowing the focus leaves states, responsive and a11y unspecified, so the engineer invents them.
Recommendation: A because your instructions ask for all seven dimensions and the plan is thin everywhere.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Pros / cons:
A) All 7 passes (recommended)
  ✅ Covers hierarchy, states, journey, slop, system, responsive, decisions
  ✅ Matches the requested scope of reviewing all seven dimensions
  ❌ More individual questions, one per gap found in the plan
B) Hero only (alignment, spacing, CTA weight)
  ✅ Fastest path to fixing the three problems the plan names explicitly
  ✅ Fewer questions, quicker to an implementable hero section
  ❌ Leaves responsive, a11y and states unspecified for implementation
Net: full coverage vs. speed on the three named hero problems.
